script.text: You did it. You won. Goodbye.
It's my fault.
Don't be silly, Mai. I caused my own downfall. I thought if I won, I could make you forget about Joey Wheeler. But now I understand why he meant so much to you. The guy's got heart.
Look what the Orichalcos dragged in. My former employee. Now it's Ms. Valentine's turn to send me a soul... or to give up her own. Ha ha ha ha ha!
How could he do this? Valon's the one who told me I have to duel for myself. Then he turns around and fights you to protect me?
How pathetic. He deserved this.
Hold on! Valon may have annoyed me, but no one deserves to have their soul taken away and then held captive by some power-hungry psychopath! I don't care who they are!
Ha!
You know what, Mai? As long as dat Orichalcos thing has control ova your mind, I'll never be able to talk sense into ya! As a matter of fact, the only way I can save you at this point is to duel ya!
Try saving yourself. I'm doing just fine without your help! Didn't you learn? If you cramp my style, you end up in a world of hurt!
I understand everything now, Mai. You forgot what duelin's all about. So I'm here to remind ya about the heart 'a the cards!
Grrr! If you think you're gonna teach me a lesson about Duel Monsters, you're wasting your time!
The Seal of Orichalcos!
Exhausted from his last duel with Valon, Joey was unable to finish the duel.
Congratulations... You win... I'm too exhausted... to finish...
You're wrong! I never attacked, so you didn't lose the duel! I won't let the Orichalcos take you away, Joey!
It's too late for that... I already lost the duel, so there's no turning back. I'm just glad dat if one of us had to lose our soul, it didn't have to be you, Mai.
Joey! Noooooooo!
Mai broke free of Dartz's influence over her, but Joey's soul was captured by the Orichalcos.
How could I be so selfish? You're the closest friend I ever had and how did I repay you? By leaving you for a madman who promised me power.
I'll make him regret the day he met Mai Valentine!
No way!
What happened?
He lost the duel.
Wait... Does that mean...?
Yes. His soul belongs to Dartz now.
